subject.title: fix(gateway): unblock approvals after first successful delivery

question: Should the gateway retain concurrent background completion of the remaining approval-delivery route after the first route successfully unblocks the requester?
rationale: The patch preserves existing concurrent starts and claims route-local error handling, but the protected maintainer label requires a human owner to confirm that this delivery and observability contract is intentional.

options.title: Accept first-success delivery
options.body: Merge the focused repair, treating a single accepted route as sufficient to make the approval prompt available while other started routes finish normally.

options.title: Require aggregate completion
options.body: Keep waiting for all delivery routes and pursue a different mechanism if the product requires completion-level observability before unblocking approvals.

recommendation.title: Accept first-success delivery
recommendation.body: Merge the focused repair, treating a single accepted route as sufficient to make the approval prompt available while other started routes finish normally.

likelyOwner.reason: The current repair and its stated validation cover the exact gateway approval-delivery contract under review.
